description: Curated sample set of van-friendly parkups and day-trip destinations around the UK South-West / Wales / Peak District. Coordinates are approximate from public map data. For production swap this out for a live provider (iOverlander, Park4Night, Google Places) via src/parkups.ts.

parkups.name: Clevedon Marine Lake
parkups.notes: Long promenade with the open-air lake, Victorian pier, and a flat tarmac car park that takes full-height vans in the day. Pay-and-display runs until early evening; signage is clear about overnight.
parkups.best_for: sunrise coffee stop, short walk, lake swim on warm days

parkups.name: Brean Down (National Trust)
parkups.notes: Iron-age headland jutting into the Bristol Channel. Dramatic sunset over the water. Car park is generous; free for NT members, otherwise a few quid.
parkups.best_for: golden hour walk up to the old fort

parkups.name: Cheddar Reservoir
parkups.notes: Flat 5km loop around a circular reservoir. Height barrier at the main car park — use the layby on Sharpham Road if you are over 2.1 m. Popular with dog walkers, quiet mid-afternoon.

parkups.name: Symonds Yat Rock
parkups.notes: Forestry England car park above the peregrine falcon lookout. Big enough for long-wheelbase vans. Cafe closes mid-afternoon. No overnight but a beautiful daytime stop.
parkups.best_for: packed lunch with a view of the Wye horseshoe

parkups.name: Mallards Pike, Forest of Dean
parkups.notes: Two small lakes, 3km of easy flat trails through Douglas fir. Forestry England parking, good for medium vans.
parkups.best_for: cool shaded walk on a hot day

parkups.name: Porlock Weir
parkups.notes: Tiny harbour on the Exmoor coast. Overnight by arrangement at the harbour car park — pay in the honesty box. Sound of the tide is unreal at 3am.
parkups.best_for: overnight stop, early walk along the pebble ridge

parkups.name: Burrington Combe (Mendips)
parkups.notes: Laybys along the B3134 give onto the Mendip plateau. Good scrambling, big open sky. Very quiet midweek.
parkups.best_for: short sharp hike, reset between calls

parkups.name: Kilve Beach
parkups.notes: Flat pay-and-display car park a short walk from a wide pebble beach with ammonite-bearing shale ledges. Great at low tide.

parkups.name: Crickhowell / Table Mountain Layby
parkups.notes: Layby at the foot of Crug Hywel (Table Mountain). Fine for overnight, no facilities. 90-minute walk to the flat summit with a sweeping view of the Usk valley.

parkups.name: Tintern Abbey Riverside
parkups.notes: Riverside car park opposite the abbey. Flat, easy access. Tintern village has a couple of decent pubs for an evening meal before heading back.
